changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionOwner') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Fusionowner_Asset' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'FusionOwner' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'dbo' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionOwner] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_Fusionowner_Asset] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionOwner_Fusion' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'FusionOwner' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'dbo' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionOwner] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionOwner_Fusion] END
exec sp_rename 'dbo.FusionOwner', 'FusionOwner_backup'; END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionOwner_backup') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'dbo.FusionOwner_backup', 'FusionOwner'; END
